title: Hotspawn Lobby Reverse Engineering & Automated 4-8h Cadence

fixture_api.auth: None (public JSON endpoint used by Hotspawn Angular frontend)
fixture_api.contract: JSON array of fixtures containing id, participants, scheduled_start_time, lock_time, competition_name, tier, offered_points. Fails closed if empty, duplicate IDs, or schema mismatch.

lobby_hydration.how: Extract embedded <script id="ng-state"> JSON containing hydrated /api/v1/fixtures payload and permalink maps.

cs2_lobby.how: SSR HTML filtered to CS2 pickems. Cross-referenced against fixture API; must match active fixtures.

week_prizes.note: Weekly prize widget with tier point allocations and Steam voucher payouts.

rules.note: Scoring rules and lock windows (published 5 min; fixture data specifies lock_offset_sec=360).

cache_invalidation_and_freshness.observation: Lobby HTML responses are cached at CDN layer with Age up to 5500s. The JSON API is live and uncached.
cache_invalidation_and_freshness.mitigation: Collector appends cache-busting timestamp parameter (?cb=<epoch>) to ensure fresh SSR payload.
cache_invalidation_and_freshness.refresh_cadence: Automated GitHub Actions cron running every 4 hours (17 */4 * * *) plus 2.5h catch-up (47 2-22/4 * * *).
cache_invalidation_and_freshness.stale_detection: Snapshots older than 8 hours trigger a prominent stale-data warning banner, preserving transparency.

match_coverage.coverage_completeness: Every CS2 match in Hotspawn inventory is captured, verified, and mapped.

unbiased_origination_principle: Hotspawn crowd % picked values are NEVER used as match probability indicators. All probabilities are originated independently from prediction markets, sportsbooks, and Valve ratings.
